description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Gas franchise polygons describe where operators hold rights to use county rights-of-way. The native layer exposes polygon geometry and named attributes, including PW_ID, EDIT_SYS_DT, LAST_UPDATED_BY, NAME, DBA, ADDRESS1. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. Franchise rights do not establish actual gas service or pipe locations; source content has not been updated since 1999. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
